title: Normalized fraction colimit of module complexes with independent site universes
statement: Let C,J,u have the independent-universe site and sheafification hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-tensor-comparison-of-universes]. Let A be a commutative ring, R a commutative ring sheaf, a:A -> Gamma(R), t in A, and S=R[1/a(t)] the actual sheafified localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Suppose E is the specified additive exact sheafified tensor extension on objects and maps, U is exact restriction along the localization unit, and eta is a family of complex morphisms K -> U(E(K)) whose degreewise maps have the normalized 1-tensor section formula [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-localization-tensor-comparison-of-universes]. Use the coefficient actions of [lem-per-rational-continuous-coefficient-derived-localization]. Then for each cochain complex K, the sequential diagram with constant object K and transition t times identity has a colimit cocone c and an isomorphism c.pt -> U(E(K)) whose nth leg is eta followed by U applied to inverse(t)^n times identity. No lower bound on K is necessary.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary module localization colimit to the regular module of each section ring. Fraction restriction maps commute by uniqueness of inverses. Evaluation reflects presheaf-module colimits, and the sheafification Hom adjunction gives the sheaf colimit, with zeroth leg the localization unit.

Tensor the regular colimit with M. Tensor preserves the countable colimit by the independent-universe tensor API. The normalized restricted-extension comparison identifies the colimit object and zeroth leg. Centrality and the inverse-scalar identity determine all other legs, including t-torsion and zero localization.

Apply the module colimit degreewise. The prescribed legs are complex morphisms; their successor equation is checked in every degree. Evaluation jointly reflects complex colimits, giving the stated cocone and comparison isomorphism.

theorem scalarLocalization_complexColimitOfUniverses
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (a : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (R.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (t : A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))))]
    (E : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))))
    (hE : ∀ M, E.obj M =
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t)) M)
    (_hmap : ∀ {M N} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f = eqToHom (hE M) ≫
      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHomOfUniverses (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t)) M
        f ≫
        eqToHom (hE N).symm)
    [E.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits E] [PreservesFiniteColimits E]
    (U₀ : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))
    (hU₀ : U₀ = SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t))))
    [U₀.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits U₀] [PreservesFiniteColimits U₀]
    (unitComplex : ∀ (K : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ),
      K ⟶ (U₀.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))
    (unitSections : ∀ (K : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ) (i : ℤ),
      scalarLocalizationUnitSectionsOfUniverses (ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses R (a t))
        (K.X i) (E.obj (K.X i)) (hE (K.X i))
        ((unitComplex K).f i ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun T ↦ T.obj (E.obj (K.X i))) hU₀)))
 :
    (fun [_source : Linear A (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
      [_target : Linear (Localization.Away t) (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t))))] ↦
      ∀ (K : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ),
      ∃ (c : Cocone (Functor.ofSequence (X := fun _n : ℕ ↦ K) (fun _n ↦ t • 𝟙 K))),
        Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
        ∃ β : c.pt ≅ (U₀.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K),
          ∀ n : ℕ, (show K ⟶ c.pt from c.ι.app n) ≫ β.hom = (unitComplex K) ≫
            (U₀.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              (((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf t : Localization.Away t) ^ n) •
                𝟙 ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)))
      (_source := scalarLocalizationCoefficientLinearOfUniverses A R a)
      (_target := scalarLocalizationCoefficientLinearOfUniverses (Localization.Away t)
        (ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses R (a t)) (scalarLocalizationCoefficientMapOfUniverses A
          R a t))
